close_trigger: receiver calls close or all senders are dropped
terminal_condition: recv returns None only after buffered items are drained and outstanding permits are released or used
residual_delivery_posture: buffered messages and permit-backed sends may still appear after close
claim_ceiling: documents receiver-visible lifecycle; does not prove application-level drain completion
notes: keep separate from acceptance and observation-evidence claims
close prevents future admission but does not imply immediate empty state
